Student - Global Mobility M/F

Are you structured, detail-oriented, and interested in gaining practical experience in HR? • Job offer expiration: 24/10/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark, Hammel

You will become part of a collaborative team where accuracy, structure, and confidentiality are important parts of the daily work. • Plan and execute system testing, inspection, and validation to ensure reliability and safety.

• Language & travel: Fluent in English (spoken and written); Danish is a plus. Willing to travel ~30 days per year.

Why join us

• Work on innovative, high‑impact projects shaping the future of hydraulic brake systems.

• Be part of a supportive, collaborative culture that values sharing knowledge and continuous improvement.

• Great opportunities for personal and professional growth through learning, mentoring, and responsibility.

• Competitive compensation and benefits: salary, pension plan, health insurance, and a great lunch program.

_Some games chase trends. Subway Surfers helped define an entire genre.

_Now, we're looking for a UI/UX Designer to help shape what comes next.

This is your chance to leave your mark on one of the biggest mobile games ever made. A game with a massive global audience, instant player feedback, and a team that never settles for "good enough". The challenge? Keeping an iconic game feeling fresh, modern, and innovative for hundreds of millions of players around the world.

Come help evolve the visual experience of Subway Surfers, designing new features, game modes, and player journeys while continuously improving the experience that keeps players coming back. Some days you'll be crafting entirely new interfaces. Other days you'll make a tiny change that unlocks a surprisingly big impact. That's the fun part.

If you enjoy solving creative puzzles, have a knack for details, and seeing your work reach millions of players, then this might just be your gig.

**Responsibilities

**

• Actively refine and improve existing UI/UX to elevate player engagement and satisfaction, ensuring Subway Surfers remains intuitive, modern, and enjoyable to play.

• Design and implement intuitive, engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing features.

• Create UX wireframes, user flows, and prototypes to support feature development and player experiences.

• Help shape the visual direction of the game's interface, evolving and modernizing the experience, while staying true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Ensure a consistent visual style, tone, and user experience across all UI elements.

• Create and maintain UI documentation, design systems, and style guides to support consistency and scalability.

• Optimize UI implementations to ensure smooth performance across a wide range of mobile devices.

Life at SYBO

**In your first month...

**You'll get to know the team, the game, and the players that have made Subway Surfers one of the most successful mobile games in the world. You'll be introduced to our tools, workflows, and ways of working while building relationships across the studio. With support from your teammates, you'll begin contributing to your first projects and quickly find your footing as part of the team.

**Within 3 months...

**You'll start taking ownership of more impactful work across the game, designing engaging interfaces and helping improve the player experience through thoughtful UI/UX solutions. You'll collaborate closely with the team to iterate on designs based on player feedback, insights, and performance data.

**By 12 months...

**You'll be a trusted contributor to the future of Subway Surfers, able to lead individual UI/UX initiatives across major features. At this point, your contributions to the UI style guide and visual framework will have enabled a smoother collaboration across teams, ensuring Subway Surfers will remain an evergreen.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI design work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging player experiences.

• Strong ability to create wireframes, user flows, mockups, and polished final designs that effectively balance player needs and business goals.

• Skilled at designing, rendering, and animating high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Advanced proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Knowledge of conducting user research and translating player insights into actionable design improvements.

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4.5 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

IAM Tech Lead

Help build the technical future of IAM and drive the shift towards automated, API-driven and engineering-led identity services at TDC NET.

TDC NET plays a leading role in Denmark’s digital infrastructure, committed to delivering reliable and secure network solutions. Identity & Access Management plays a critical role in protecting our infrastructure by ensuring that the right identities have the right access, at the right time.

About the job

We are looking for an experienced IAM Tech Lead to provide technical leadership across our Identity & Access Management landscape and accelerate our journey towards a more automated, standardized and engineering-driven IAM environment.

You will help define the technical direction across Identity Governance & Administration, Directory Services, Authentication & Federation, Privileged Access Management, PKI and IAM Engineering & Automation, working closely with platform and service owners.

A key focus will be to reduce manual IAM operations through automation and standardization, using APIs, scripting, workflow orchestration, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.

Drive the technical implementation of the IAM Service Intake and Automation Model, standardizing and automating IAM requests across Jira, ServiceNow, IGA and other IAM platforms.

You will establish reusable engineering patterns for integrations, automation, testing, deployment and monitoring, while improving the resilience and operational readiness of IAM services.

As a hands-on technical leader, you will lead complex IAM designs and modernization initiatives, guide engineers and contribute directly to integrations, automation and troubleshooting.

Our IAM landscape includes Omada, Microsoft Active Directory and Entra ID, Ping Identity, Delinea PAM, HashiCorp Vault/Boundary and enterprise PKI.

What you will help drive:

IAM Technical Leadership

Provide technical direction across the IAM landscape, lead complex solution designs and establish common technical standards in collaboration with IAM platform and service owners.

IAM Engineering & Automation

Transform manual IAM processes into API-driven and automated services using scripting, workflow automation, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD and automated testing.

Service Intake & Orchestration

Drive the technical implementation of standardized IAM service intake, routing, orchestration and automated fulfilment across Jira, ServiceNow, IGA and other IAM platforms.

IAM Modernization

Reduce legacy dependencies and technical debt while supporting the transition towards modern, scalable and resilient identity technologies.

Engineering Standards & Reliability

Establish reusable patterns for source control, integrations, configuration management, testing, deployment, monitoring and logging to ensure IAM automation is maintainable and operationally reliable.

"We are looking for someone who can combine deep IAM expertise with an engineering mindset and help us move from manual processes towards standardized and automated identity services. This is an opportunity to help shape how we engineer and modernize IAM across TDC NET," says Abhishek Kumar, Senior Manager, IAM, TDC NET

About you

We are looking for someone who combines engineering and automation mindset and expertise within IAM area.

• 7+ years of professional experience within Identity & Access Management, including significant experience in senior engineering, solution design or technical leadership responsibilities

• Extensive experience with IAM engineering, solution design and enterprise integrations

• Direct experience with automation, APIs and scripting, using PowerShell, Python or similar technologies

• Experience with DevOps engineering practices, including Git, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, configuration management and automated testing

• Experience designing API-driven integrations, workflow orchestration and automated service fulfilment

• Deep knowledge of enterprise directory, identity and access technologies, including Active Directory, Entra ID, OpenLDAP, Keycloak or equivalent platforms, with solid understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorization and federation.

• Experience with key IAM capabilities such as IGA, SSO/Federation, MFA, PAM, PKI and Secrets Management

• Good understanding of standards and protocols such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM and LDAP

• Ability to define technical standards, reusable engineering patterns and implementation guardrails

• Ability to lead technical designs, troubleshoot complex problems and provide technical guidance to engineers

• Extensive understanding of security principles including Zero Trust, least privilege, privileged access and segregation of duties

• Solid communication and collaboration skills across engineering, architecture, security, operations and business teams

You are comfortable moving between architecture, engineering and implementation. You can create technical direction while remaining close enough to the technology to build, challenge and troubleshooting solutions.

You naturally look at repetitive activities and ask how they can be standardized, automated and operated more efficiently.
